architecture_deltas.proposed_change: Add a VisualStateTransition semantic record to canonical UnifiedDB and a rebuildable transition topology projection to ClayGraph. Each accepted edge binds pre_perceptual_state evidence, task_state/context, proposed effect identity, deterministic authority/effect receipt, observed post_state evidence, verified outcome, causal credit eligibility, model/mmproj/feature hashes and timestamps. Retrieval may propose prior transition paths through EAP/ActiveAssembly but may never execute effects or mint truth. On mismatch, unknown state or VISUAL_ALIAS_CONFLICT, abandon the fast path and re-ground using current perception/full decode/active sensing.
architecture_deltas.expected_benefit: Convert verified GUI experience into compact action-grounded transition structure, reduce repeated full VLM interpretation on recurring states, improve long-horizon task continuity and make post-action verification explicit.
architecture_deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Partial observability and visual aliasing dominate real desktop GUIs; transition reuse either becomes unsafe or escalates so often that it adds complexity without end-to-end benefit.
architecture_deltas.discriminating_test: Q23-T-VSTG-MATRIX-01 plus experience-dose study N={0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64}; include stale layouts, hidden operations, visual twins with distinct task state, shuffled edges, wrong seeds and restart replay.
architecture_deltas.resource_budget: Must be Pareto-competitive with QWEN_ONLY/PAR under target-VPS total pathway cost; graph activation and retrieval overhead are included, not hidden.
architecture_deltas.rollback: Disable VSTG retrieval/projection and retain QNDRF/PAR/direct-memory baselines; transition records remain provenance evidence but are not active routing inputs.

architecture_deltas.proposed_change: Introduce VISUAL_ALIAS_CONFLICT as an abstention state when a perceptual fingerprint resolves to incompatible task states, transition edges or outcomes above the current ambiguity threshold. Conflict cannot be collapsed by retrieval popularity; it requires task/context disambiguation, active sensing or semantic decode.
architecture_deltas.expected_benefit: Prevents high-confidence visual similarity from becoming a self-confirming memory/action loop.
architecture_deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Conflict frequency is high enough to erase fast-path gains.
architecture_deltas.discriminating_test: Q23-T-ALIAS-01 with visually identical/near-identical UI fixtures and incompatible hidden/task states.
architecture_deltas.rollback: Remove gate from routing while preserving conflict telemetry for analysis.
